extensionsPage.title: Extensions
extensionsPage.subtitle: Browse the marketplace and manage built-in and installed extensions.
extensionsPage.emptyBuiltin: No built-in extensions were discovered by the gateway (check gateway logs and dist/extensions manifests).
extensionsPage.emptyUser: No user-installed extensions found. Install from the marketplace or CLI into ~/.xopc/extensions.
extensionsPage.cardTooltipHasUi: Declares Gateway console UI (pages or settings).
extensionsPage.cardTooltipNoUi: No Gateway UI; may still expose tools, hooks, or channels.
extensionsPage.detailNoDescription: No description was provided for this extension.
extensionsPage.restartNote: Some extension changes require restarting the gateway for code to fully load.
extensionsPage.cliManageHint: This copy is not bundled with xopc — install, remove, and upgrades are done via the CLI or filesystem.
extensionsPage.builtinConfigHint: Channels and image provider keys are managed under Settings → Channels and Settings → Images.
extensionsPage.builtinToggleRestartHint: Restart the gateway so extension code fully loads or unloads.
extensionsPage.backendOnlyHint: This extension has no Gateway UI; tools and hooks still run when enabled.
extensionsPage.marketplaceNoReadme: No readme was published for this package.
extensionsPage.marketplaceUninstallConfirm: Remove this extension from disk and disable it in config? Restart the gateway if it stays listed.
extensionsPage.marketplaceReinstallConfirm: Overwrite the existing install with the marketplace version?
extensionsPage.marketplaceRestartHint: Restart the gateway to fully apply channel plugins or unload removed code.
extensionsPage.marketplaceBuiltinManageHint: This package ships with xopc — it is not installed from the store. Use the Built-in tab to open its UI or change enablement.

extensionUi.permissionSubtitle: This extension may use the following capabilities while its UI is open.
extensionUi.permissionsNone: No additional permissions are declared in the manifest.
extensionUi.deniedHint: The extension UI stays hidden until you approve it for this browser.
extensionUi.loadFailed: The extension panel failed to load.
extensionUi.loadFailedConnectionHint: If the frame shows “connection refused”, start the xopc gateway (and if you use Vite for web/, match the proxy target in web/vite.config.ts).

extensionDebug.title: Extension debug
extensionDebug.subtitle: Inspect discovered extensions, declared permissions, and browser UI approval state.
extensionDebug.grantsHint: Key `xopc.extensionUiGrants.v1` in localStorage — fingerprints of permission lists you approved per extension.
extensionDebug.futureBody: PostMessage capture, per-extension storage preview, and live permission overrides are planned for a future iteration.
